summary: String parameters added to tracked set but never seeded into env -> misclassified as unbound-variable instead of runtime-unknown hole.
fix: Seed env[paramName] = SqlUnknownHole(null, paramName) for each String parameter in Analyze(). Made SqlUnknownHole.OriginalExpression nullable to allow synthesized holes without a real source expression.

summary: Combinatorial-blowup safeguard runs after Flatten materializes the full cross-product -> excessive time/memory before the cap fires.
fix: Added CardinalityCapped(value, cap) precheck in BuildSite. On overflow (cap+1 sentinel), use FlattenWithLimit which never materializes more than MaxRepresentativeSamples leaves at any intermediate accumulator. Within-cap path keeps the existing full Flatten enumeration.

summary: Loop bodies mutate shared env as if executed once -> fabricates one-iteration post-loop SQL state.
fix: Added WalkLoopBody helper. Snapshots env before walking the body, then post-loop replaces any tracked-variable whose value changed (or was newly introduced) with SqlUnknownHole(null, '<loop-mutation:varName>'). Execution sites inside the loop body still see in-flight mutated state for site detection.
